method: 32 paired seeded fixtures: 24 mirror-roster matches over three quality/style groups, plus the eight original catalog audit fixtures; equal numbers of 180 and 300 second matches. All outcomes simulated at 1/60 second steps. Turnovers are secure opposition control or an opposition restart following possession, excluding shots, goals and period endings. Reception errors include recovered bobbles; they are not all turnovers. No turnover or shot quotas. These are a calibration sample, not population guarantees.

fixedOppositionCheck.method: Eight additional matches: two seeds, both durations, home 80 balanced or elite possession versus a fixed 73 balanced away XI. Separate from the 32-match paired before/after sample.
